hero.title: Plan Your Stay
hero.subtitle: A day, a weekend, or a week — here is how it works.

intro:
Sømliøya is rented as a whole — when you come, the island is yours.

There is no booking calendar and no fixed packages. Every stay starts with a conversation: tell us your dates, how many of you there are, and what you hope the island can be. We will tell you honestly whether it fits.

steps.title: Write to us
steps.description: Send an enquiry with your dates, group size and what you have in mind — a quiet retreat, a family gathering, a celebration, a ritual. We reply within a day or two.

steps.title: Shape the stay
steps.description: We help you plan the practical side: boat transfer, what to bring, food, firewood, and anything you want prepared before you arrive.

steps.title: Arrive and slow down
steps.description: A short boat trip brings you across Årsetfjorden. From the moment you step ashore, the island — and its pace — is yours.

practicalSection.heading: Practical Details
practicalSection.paragraphs:
The island is intentionally simple. Stays are self-catered: the main house has a large shared kitchen, and meals tend to happen around the fire or the long table.

Getting here: the nearest airports are Rørvik and Namsos; Trondheim is around three hours away by car. The boat crossing from the mainland is short, and we will arrange it with you.

facts.label: Sleeps
facts.detail: Simple bedrooms across two buildings, with space to pitch tents for larger groups.

facts.label: Duration
facts.detail: From a single day to a full week. Weekends are the most requested — enquire early.

facts.label: Facilities
facts.detail: Shared kitchen, living room with fireplace, hot showers, workshop space for groups and retreats.

facts.label: Getting here
facts.detail: Short boat transfer across the fjord, arranged together with us when you book.

ratesSection.heading: Rates
ratesSection.paragraphs:
Rates depend on the season, the length of your stay and the size of your group. Tell us your dates and we will send you a clear quote — no hidden costs, no fine print.

A day visit is priced differently from an overnight stay, and longer stays are priced kindly.
